test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: National Song 'Vande Mataram', written by Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay, is a part of which of these novels?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anandmath**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay **wrote the **national song 'Vande Mataram**'.
 
• It was a **part **of his **novel Anandamath (1882).**
 
• It is a **political novel depicting **a **Sanyasi army fighting British soldiers**.
 
• The poem was **first sung by Rabindranath Tagore **in the **1896 session **of the **Indian National Congress**.
 
• On **24 January 1950**, the **Constituent Assembly **of India has **adopted "Vande Mataram" as a national song**.
 
• On **this occasion**, the **first President of India**, **Rajendra Prasad **stated that the **song should be honoured equally with the national **anthem of India, **Jana Gana Mana**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Durgeshnandini **is a **Bengali historical romance novel **written by Indian writer **Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay in 1865**.
 
• **Devi Chaudhurani **is a **Bengali novel **written by **Bankim Chandra Chatterjee **and **published in 1884**. It was later translated to English by Subodh Chunder Mitter.
 
• **Kapalkundala **is a **Bengali romance novel **by Indian writer **Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay**. **Published in 1866**.
